nome: errno: o ERANGE do strtol que estoura

import <limits.h>
errno = 0

printf("%d %d %d\n", errno == ERANGE, ERANGE, r == LONG_MAX)

nome: stddef: offsetof de um struct do programa, sizeof de size_t e ptrdiff_t, NULL
c_topo: struct ponto { char c; int x; double y; };
jinga:
struct ponto {
    char c
    int x
    double y
}
int v[5]
int *p = &v[4]
ptrdiff_t d = p - v
printf("%zu %zu %zu %zu %td %d\n", offsetof(struct ponto, c), offsetof(struct ponto, x), offsetof(struct ponto, y), sizeof(size_t), d, NULL == Null)

nome: time: gmtime e strftime de um instante fixo
jinga:
time_t t = 1700000000
struct tm *u = gmtime(&t)
char buf[64]
strftime(buf, sizeof(buf), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S %j %a", u)
printf("%s %d %d\n", buf, u->tm_wday, u->tm_yday)

nome: time: asctime de gmtime, difftime, e o time e o clock andando
jinga:
time_t zero = 0
printf("%s", asctime(gmtime(&zero)))
printf("%.1f %d %d\n", difftime(10, 4), time(NULL) > 0, clock() >= 0)
